identity: Classical Arabic philosophical narrative (12th-c. Andalusi): the ontological-inquiry stretch of Ibn Tufayl's Hayy ibn Yaqzan. Third-person report of one continuous chain of reasoning — from species-specific forms, to bodies composed of few vs. many maani, to tridimensional extension, to the distinction of extension from what is extended (the clay/sphere analogy), to prime matter (al-madda wa-l-hayula); then the retreat from the intelligible world back to sense, the examination of the four elements beginning with water, the discovery that forms are generated and so require an Agent (fail), closing with a hadith qudsi and Quran 8:17. Register: formal narrative prose built of long periodic chains hinged on wa-, fa-, and thumma; the recurring verbs are verbs of cognition (raa, alima, tabayyana lahu, laha lahu, nazara, tafakkara, itabara, talaba, akhadha).
law: The sentence unit is one complete narrative-cognitive MOVE: a cognition/action verb plus everything that finishes that one act. Boundaries fall (1) before thumma / thumma innahu, which always marks a new step; (2) before the formulaic wa-kadhalika (+ raa or a nominal), which the source itself uses as a paragraph-opener and therefore as a sentence-opener; (3) before wa- + finite verb or wa- + a nominal predication that launches a NEW assertion; (4) before ghayr anna, which turns the argument; (5) before fa- + a verb of COGNITION (fa-alima, fa-tabayyana lahu, fa-laha lahu) when it draws a fresh inference from an already-completed result. Boundaries do NOT fall (a) before fa- + the verb that ANSWERS an immediately preceding question or search (fa-nazara hal yajid ... fa-lam yajid; thumma tafakkara ... hal ... fa-raa; tatabbaa l-suwar ... fa-raa) — search and finding are one move; (b) before fa- + a short consequential ACTION or state verb (fa-talaba, fa-akhkhara, fa-qasada, fa-taqahqara, fa-zalat, fa-irtasama); (c) before a coordinate anna-complement, a hal (circumstantial) wa- + nominal clause, or a coordinate wa-la negation inside one negative series; (d) before li-anna, idh, hatta, kama, alladhi/allati. Structural constants: the token before every <NL> and the final token always close a sentence; an <NL> never carries one. Resulting rhythm: about 22 tokens per sentence.
reasoning: GRANULARITY FIRST. The source's own paragraph breaks are the only certain evidence, so I read them as a calibration sample. Their opening tokens are fa-tabayyana, wa-kadhalika raa, wa-kana, fa-idha, fa-nazara, thumma tafakkara, wa-itabara, fa-laha, WA-ANNAHU, wa-lakin, wa-hadha, fa-lamma, wa-akhadha, fa-awwal, fa-lamma, thumma innahu, thumma innahu, wa-fi. Two consequences. (i) Both fa- and wa- are freely sentence-initial in this text, so neither can be treated as a blanket keep-joined marker. (ii) P10 opens on wa-annahu — a coordinate anna-complement of P9's fa-laha lahu anna — and P19 is only three tokens (wa-fi muhkam al-tanzil). A source that cuts that finely is not writing 40-token sentences throughout; therefore the 105-, 89-, 78-, 68-, 66- and 62-token paragraphs must be multi-sentence, while the 3-, 12-, 15-, 15-, 20- and 22-token paragraphs are single sentences. That fixes the target rhythm near 22 tokens. || SITE 17 (anha, before fa-alima). Took it. The wa-raa clause (18 tokens) is a complete observation and fa-alima anna dhalika sadirun draws the inference from it. I make this consistent across all three fa-alima sites — 17, 284, 741 — since fa- + cognition-verb is exactly what the source uses to open P2 (fa-tabayyana), P6 (fa-nazara) and P9 (fa-laha). || SITE 35 (al-hayawan). Took it, hi. wa-kadhalika li-kulli wahidin min anwa al-nabat mithlu dhalika is a fresh nominal predication opening on the formula that the source itself uses to begin P3. || SITES 123, 137. Took both, hi. P3 opens on wa-kadhalika raa and then repeats that exact string twice more; a phrase the source proves to be sentence-initial cannot be sentence-medial fourteen tokens later. This yields a legitimate 4-token sentence (wa-kadhalika raa al-nar wa-l-hawa), which P19's 3-token paragraph licenses. || SITES 76, 102, 116 (before fa-talaba, fa-akhkhara, fa-qasada). Declined. Each is a short action-consequence completing the cognition that governs it (alima ... fa-talaba; raa ... fa-akhkhara). These set rule (b). || P4 (143-220), the 78-token outlier. Declined all internal cuts, including 183 before fa-la yumkinu an yataharraka. Everything from token 149 onward sits inside the anna-complement chain governed by sabaqa ila zannihi (anna A, wa-anna B, wa-anna C), and fa-la yumkin spells out the entailment of an yakuna khulwan min al-maani; a period there would sever an entailment from its own premise. The trailing li-anna and fa-laysat idhan are subordinate/concluding and are barred by rule (d). I accept one genuinely long periodic sentence rather than break my own rules to flatten the length histogram — P10's wa-annahu is a PARAGRAPH break imposed by layout, not evidence that periods land before coordinate anna inside a paragraph. || SITES 263 and 341. Declined both, and this is the pair that sets rule (a). fa-nazara hal yajid wasfan wahidan ... fa-lam yajid shayan is one search-and-finding; likewise thumma tafakkara ... hal huwa ... aw laysa l-amru kadhalika, fa-raa anna waraa hadha l-imtidad manan akhar. The fa- clause is the ANSWER to the question just posed, not a new move. Same shape at 793 (nazara ila dhawat al-suwar / fa-lam yara) and 776 (tatabbaa l-suwar sura sura / fa-raa annaha kulluha haditha) — declined for the same reason. This leaves P7 as a single 53-token sentence, which I accept because wa-anna l-imtidad wahdahu at 355 is a coordinate complement barred by rule (c). || SITE 284. Took it. Once the finding is complete (illa mana l-imtidad ... bi-l-tul wa-l-ard wa-l-umq), fa-alima anna hadha l-mana huwa li-l-jism is a NEW inference on top of it — the very contrast that rule (5) draws against rule (a). Declined 294 before lakinnahu: bare adversative lakin without waw joins a contrast inside one thought (P11's sentence-initial case is WA-lakin at a paragraph head, a different thing). || P8 (375-463), five sentences. 392 hi: thumma inna is categorical. Declined 420 before wa-l-tinu wahidun bi-aynihi lam yatabaddal — that is a hal clause, 'while the clay itself is one and unchanged', hanging off wa-sarat ala qadrin akhar. Took 425 and 443, the two ghayr anna turns, each introducing a distinct qualification. Took 453 because 444-453 and 454-463 are a matched antithetical pair — li-taaqubiha alayhi tabayyana lahu annaha manan ala hiyalih / wa-li-kawnihi la yara bi-l-jumla anha tabayyana lahu annaha min haqiqatih — and a matched pair implies two sentences. || P11 (519-556). Declined 537. wa-lladhi yathbutu ala halin wahida is the second arm of a balanced antithesis under one wa-lakin; both arms share the frame, so this 38-token period is one sentence. Same call at 572 in P12, where wa-hiya ariyatun an al-sura jumla is an appended hal. || SITE 601. Declined. fa-lamma intaha nazaruhu ... istawhasha wa-hanna ... fa-taqahqara is a single when-then-so period, and fa-taqahqara is an action-consequence under rule (b). || P15 (635-694), four sentences. Declined 639 (fa-awwal ma nazara ila l-ma FA-raa is one construction, the fa- being the rabt of awwalu ma). Took 654 before fa-idha sukhkhina — a new conditional period with its own protasis and apodosis; took 673 before fa-zala anhu bi-l-jumla al-wasfan, the summarizing predication; took 684 before wa-lam yarif, where the subject switches from the water back to Hayy. || P16 (696-763). Declined 702 (fa-zalat, action-consequence) and 719 (wa-hadathat lahu suratun ukhra is the antithetical twin of fa-zalat al-sura al-maiyya — vanishing and coming-to-be are one move). Took 741 before fa-alima bi-l-darura anna kulla hadathin la budda lahu min muhdith, the paragraph's whole point. Declined 751 before fa-irtasama by rule (b). || P18 (788-892), six sentences — forced by its 105-token length and confirmed site by site. Declined 806 (mithl al-ma fa-innahu is an exemplification appended to the preceding clause). Took 819 (fa-dhalika l-istidad huwa suratuh, the conclusion drawn from the example), 836 (fa-suluh al-jism ... huwa istidaduh bi-suratih, a second nominal restatement), 845 (wa-laha lahu, wa- + new cognition verb), 852 (fa-tabayyana lahu, fresh inference on top of a completed result — the same shape as 284). Took 870 hi: wa-hadha l-mana lladhi laha lahu wa-huwa qawlu rasuli llah pivots from philosophy to scriptural corroboration, the sharpest topical seam in the document. || P20. Declined 902 inside the quoted verse of Quran 8:17; the verse is set on its own line as a single citation and the internal waqf after qatalahum is not a period.
